# FLX-5012: the committed state is older than the declared maximum age

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

SEAM-FIDELITY-SPEC §7: the ship gate compares the state's commitment time against budget.maxStateAge. A state older than that is refused rather than reused, so a fidelity record cannot be carried forward past the window its own declaration granted it.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5012
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
